towns.name: Uziz
towns.summary: Uziz (25.2S 28.3E) is the Gharu'ndim town in the heart of the Yushad Ridge, settled after explorers from Samsur found a calm, clear pool of fresh water that scholars believe is an Empyrean reservoir; during the Disturbance in the Desert its people were abducted and replaced by Simulacra. The town is one long street on a terrace (z 20): a west row of big yellow-green domed halls and flat rooftop-garden houses (The Lofty Spire, The Shining Word, The Thirsty Blade) and an east row of smaller shops, octagon towers and a fire bowl; the straight Empyrean canal (z 12) runs parallel below the terrace to the west. The civic heart at the north end has the nullified skeleton statue on its pillar, the Town Network portal, a stained-glass church tower, a great spreading tree, the Life Stone and the Haven Residential Halls portal; east of town two sheer rock pillars of the ridge rise to z 106 and z 126.
